prose: Whiteboard (YC W26) is an open-source desktop IDE where humans and agents architect software together in a common workspace. It plugs into the tools developers already use, such as Claude Code and Codex, and gives the agent an SDK to draw on an in-app canvas to describe its work - for example proposing API examples and motivations for a stack of commits, or explaining the telemetry changes in a PostHog PR and how to build dashboards from them.
The makers say Whiteboard works best with frontier models such as GPT-6 Sol and Claude. It is available as a macOS download, with the code on GitHub and a one-minute demo video.
highlights: Open-source desktop IDE for humans and agents to architect software together.
Plugs into existing agent tools like Claude Code and Codex.
Agents get an SDK to draw their plans on an in-app canvas.
Example use: propose an API for a commit stack, or explain a PostHog telemetry PR.
